description: Modifier that marks a member as overriding a base member. It is an error when no base member with that name exists.
Compiler option that requires `override` on every member that overrides a base class member.
`super(...)` calls the base constructor; `super.method()` calls the base implementation from an override.
Inside a constructor, the class actually invoked with `new`, which may be a subclass.
`declare value: string` redeclares a field type in a subclass without emitting a field initializer.
